ReleaseRegisterRequest.two-amd64.json.note: Both amd64 and arm64 must be present, with unique OS/version/architecture tuples (§13.3–§13.4); signatures are valid TEST ONLY signatures.

UsageEvent.gap-on-complete.json.note: gap is present iff quality=gap (§10.5); payload hash is correct.

UsageEvent.inverted-interval.json.note: interval_end must be greater than interval_start (§10.5); payload hash is correct.

PolicyRevisionCreate.fup-nonmonotonic.js.note: Thresholds must strictly increase (§11.1). All sample rates and thresholds are TEST ONLY.

PolicyRevisionCreate.approved-not-servin.note: Approved releases must be a subset of serving releases (§13.2).

PolicyRevisionCreate.revoked-overlap.jso.note: Revoked releases must be disjoint from serving and approved releases (§13.2).

PolicyRevisionCreate.domain-duplicate.js.note: Duplicate semantic domain rules after IDNA normalization are rejected (§12.4).

CheckoutSessionRequest.non-allowlisted.j.note: TEST ONLY allowlist: https://portal.example.invalid; this host is absent (§16.2).

UpdateResult.health-null-on-check.json.note: health is null only for a failed result whose stage precedes checking. stage check already ran the health profile (D-062); payload hash is correct.

BillingPortalSessionRequest.non-allowlis.note: TEST ONLY allowlist: https://portal.example.invalid; this host is absent (§16.2).

UsageBatchRequest.retired-window.json.note: The event has a valid immutable hash, but interval_end exceeds retired_at plus one sampling interval from vectors/usage-retired-handoff.json. Reject per event with VALIDATION_FAILED and audit; never advance its original stream ACK.
